evidence_quotes.O: I've reviewed a number of corded over-the-ear and in-ear headphones over the last few months, and I've discovered what good headphones are capable of.
evidence_quotes.C: After pairing this unit with my Droid X, I evaluated it for sound quality, ease of use, and comfort.
evidence_quotes.E: The iSport are my active use headphones while I plan to use the DNA for other settings - at my desk, Starbucks, etc.
evidence_quotes.A: I prefer a flat keyboard or ones with pop-up feet that other people can use if they want the keyboard tilted.
evidence_quotes.N: The sound could be a little better, but it is good enough for me.
